'''Robert Clyde "Bobby" Jones''' (born [[December 18]], [[1951]] in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]]) is a former pro [[basketball]] player. 

Jones was known for his outstanding defensive play, earning him eight All-Defensive team nominantions in the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]]. He began his pro career with the [[Denver Nuggets]] of the [[American Basketball Association|ABA]] in [[1974]], where he played until [[1978]]. He joined the [[Philadelphia 76ers]], where he played until [[1986]]. He was a member of the [[1983]] Sixers team that became world champions.
